# netbox_ipam_roles (Data Source)

Retrieves all ipam roles from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_ipam_roles" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "name"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "ipam_roles_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_ipam_roles.example.ipam_roles[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ipam_roles` (Attributes List) The ipam roles found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipam_roles))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--ipam_roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipam_roles`

Read-Only:

- `asn_count` (Number) The number of asn objects that refer to the ipam roles.

- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the ipam roles, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the ipam roles.
- `id` (Number) The id of the ipam roles.
- `last_updated` (String) When the ipam roles was last changed.
- `name` (String) The name of the ipam roles.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the ipam roles.
- `prefix_count` (Number) The number of prefix objects that refer to the ipam roles.
- `slug` (String) The slug of the ipam roles.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `vlan_count` (Number) The number of vlan objects that refer to the ipam roles.
- `weight` (Number) The weight of the ipam roles.
